name: ind2gray
expr: ig = ind2gray([1 2 3; 3 4 5], cm_gray); ir = ind2gray([1 2 3 4 5], cm_rgb); iu8 = double(ind2gray(uint8([0 1 4; 2 3 4]), cm_rgb)); iu16 = double(ind2gray(uint16([0 1 1000; 4 4 4]), cm_rgb)); ic = ind2gray([-1 0 6 10], cm_rgb);
covers: ind2gray(X, MAP)            double / single X — 1-based lookup
ind2gray(uint8 X, MAP)      class-preserving uint8 output via 256-LUT
ind2gray(uint16 X, MAP)     class-preserving uint16 output via 65536-LUT
out-of-range index clamping (both float and integer)
comment: MATLAB ind2gray algorithm: graycm = rgb2gray(MAP) → take column 1 → length-N grey vector. Then class-preserving lookup. Float X uses 1-based indexing with clamp to [1, M]; integer X (uint8/uint16) uses 0-based indexing with LUT padded to vs=256/65536 using last grey value beyond M-1. Coefficients are the BT.601 YIQ luma (0.298936021293775, 0.587043074451121, 0.114020904255103). Bit-equal MATLAB R2025b on all probed test vectors including the RGB-cmap case where the previous numkit impl was wrong (it just took column 0 of MAP instead of applying rgb2gray).
